sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule AS m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#' AND (a1.element = 'h' OR a2.element = 'h'))
